sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 600. Deals physical damage 5 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 20 seconds for one time only. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 120 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Status ailment resistance boosted by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 30000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
